name: One-Pan Baked Shrimp, Tomato and Feta Orzo

components.name: Shrimp, Tomato and Feta Orzo
steps: Heat oven to 200 C and mix raw orzo, stock, tomatoes, pepper, onion, garlic, oil, oregano and salt in a deep baking dish.
Cover securely with foil and bake 20-25 minutes; check that most orzo has softened and there is still enough liquid for the pasta. Add small amounts of hot water if needed.
Toss peeled raw shrimp with lemon and nestle into the hot orzo; scatter feta on top.
Bake uncovered a further 10-15 minutes, stirring once if necessary, until the shrimp are opaque and register 63 C.
Fold through parsley, divide six servings and chill in shallow containers promptly. Avoid prolonged cooking that toughens shrimp.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.
